minor.issue: On partial PATCH that omits `tax` while touching line_items/discount/shipping, backend re-reads the stored `existing.tax` (which already includes rolled-up per-line tax) and passes it into _sum_lines, which adds line_tax_total AGAIN → double-count of per-line tax. Frontend BillEditor/InvoiceEditor always send tax explicitly in buildBody so users don't hit it, but any external API caller or future partial-patch code path (e.g. inline row edit) would silently corrupt totals. Fix: on PATCH, use only doc-level tax (subtract line_tax_total when reusing existing.tax), or store doc-level tax and line_tax_total separately.

action_items: Bills/Invoices PATCH double-counts per-line tax when caller omits `tax` field — see backend minor issue. Non-blocking today because frontend always sends `tax`, but worth fixing for API robustness.

React console warning: 'Cannot update a component (AiPanel) while rendering a different component (WelcomeModal)' — WelcomeModal is calling setState on AiPanel during render. Not a functional bug but flag for cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/invoices.py _sum_lines mutates the caller's line items in-place (sets `tax_amount` on each dict). Fine for POST/PATCH where the payload is short-lived, but if a caller reuses the same dict list it will surprise them. Consider deep-copying or documenting the mutation.

routes/invoices.py update_tax cascades name/rate into invoice and bill line_items via update_many with arrayFilters — this rewrites HISTORICAL documents. Comment in code says only display fields update, but for a tax rate change on a rate that was applied to a locked/paid invoice, the tax_rate on the line will silently shift while stored tax_amount stays put — the doc becomes internally inconsistent (rate=15 but tax_amount computed from old rate=13). Consider limiting cascade to open/unpaid docs.

Sidebar.jsx label→testid derivation `label.replace(/\s+/g,'-').toLowerCase()` produces testids with parentheses like `nav-link-customers-(contacts)` — brittle for CSS selectors that don't escape parens. Consider a stable slug field per item instead of deriving from label.

rca of the issue: PATCH double-count: `existing.tax` in Mongo is the ALREADY-ROLLED-UP figure (doc-level input + Σ line_tax). When _sum_lines runs again on PATCH, it treats `existing.tax` as doc-level input and re-adds Σ line_tax on top, so any partial PATCH that doesn't explicitly override `tax` inflates it by the line_tax_total. Reproduction: create a bill with lines that have tax_rate>0 and no explicit doc-level tax, then PATCH only {shipping:X}. Expected doc.tax unchanged; actual doc.tax = previous + line_tax_total. Mitigation options: (a) store doc-level tax input separately from computed tax; or (b) subtract Σ current line_tax_amount from `existing.tax` before passing to _sum_lines on PATCH; or (c) require callers to always resend `tax`. Frontend BillEditor/InvoiceEditor already do (c), so no user impact today.
